concerns.text: FR-007 (log substrate mass, integration time) and SC-004 (environmental compliance) lack a verified implementation path. Tasks T060 and T061 are marked as failed/rejected in the analyze report because their required output artifacts are missing, leaving these requirements unaddressed in the task list.

FR-007 requires logging actual measured quantities (substrate mass, integration time). Task T014 only logs default values from config when hardware is absent. There is no task to validate or log actual recorded mass/time for real-data runs, creating a gap between the requirement's intent and the implementation.

The plan forbids using raw dielectric constant and solvation energy as separate univariate predictors. Task T031 (VIF analysis) and T030a (Correlation) descriptions are ambiguous regarding whether the PCA-derived index is the *only* input for the primary model, risking a violation of the tautology avoidance constraint.

SC-010 requires 'Logged dielectric constants match the versioned lookup table reference for ≥98% of configured solvents'. Task T017a flags runs where values deviate >2%. This conflates a '2% deviation tolerance' with a '98% matching rate' success criterion, which are mathematically distinct metrics (rate vs. tolerance).

Constitution Principle VI requires quantifying deviations between simulated and observed lifetimes in `docs/deviation_analysis.md`. Task T036 only mentions updating the file to compare 'simulated vs. expected physical behaviors' without mandating the generation of a quantitative deviation metric (e.g., RMSE or % error).
